reviews.comment: Professor Lamb is great. The content is straightforward and the exams follow the content in the lectures. He doesn't go too off topic on lectures, so you'll be ok if you miss class. He is so funny and makes the class so much better. His exams are all free response, unfortunately, but not hard if you learn the content.

Dr Lamb is a super awesome, understanding, and hilarious prof. He's easy to talk to and answers any questions you may have. His lectures feel like drinking water from a power washer though. Lots of content coming at you at once with some explanation being not great. Definitely study everything in the slides before taking his quizzes.

Not much to say other than good lecturer, stringent grader. Left the class with a very solid understanding of igmet, and found the lectures to be some of the best. Grades did not reflect this as much as I felt they should. Quizzes felt tough, exam were usually curved because they were difficult, and textbook wasnt too helpful. Would take again

Grade is made up of lockdown quizzes and the exams. The exams weren't that difficult as he used old quiz questions a lot of the time. The lockdown quizzes are what ended up biting me on the end for me not to get an A. Not much room of error unless you do really well on the quizzes. Lectures were also very boring and didn't pick up much from them.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I didn't choose to take him, there was a sudden change of professors so. Prof lamb seems like a good professor, but only for those with a previous knowledge of geology. there are 12 quizzes which require a webcam and respondus lockdown they are also timed. personally his lectures didn't seem as helpful for me so I stuck to the book and quizlet.

Good guy rocks aren't super interesting but he does his best. Crazy curves on almost everything like ten plus point bump on every exam, and a pretty generous curve after the final. I averaged like an 85 between all of the tests and the quizzes and that was after a curve and still ended up with a 93.

had professor lamb for geology 101 spring 2024. the class consisted of 12 quizzes, 3 exams, midterm, and final. no extra credit opportunities. weekly quiz is timed, requires lockdown browser, and webcam. seemed to be easy for those students with a background in geology however i did not have that. this course was the hardest i took this semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Expected this class to be an easy A, wasn't had to work for it. This class was not hard there was minimal work it's just the exams that get you because this class is very memorization heavy and you need to read to pass. He seemed like a nice guy but he used this old speaker and it was nearly impossible to hear or understand a single word. (google:)

Dr. Lamb was really a solid professor, but not close to the best I ever had. Gave some pretty good lectures. Lectures were really important on exams. I used the textbook quite a bit ( most chapters but not all) on areas he didn't cover enough. I had him when COVID hit so I give him a pass since class when online halfway through the year.

The quizzes are the most difficult part of this course. What I found most helpful is to read and take notes over the chapter before his lecture, that way you will have a better understanding of the material. Professor Lamb is really good about helping, but you need to ask for it rather than expect it.

The lectures were pretty boring and long but attendance isn't necessary. There were quizzes every week but they weren't difficult if you read the material. The tests were just made up of quiz questions so that's great. It's a lot on content but no math so I think it's a good choice for a science credit. Prof Lamb is kind and gives extra credit.

Dr. Lamb was the nicest professor I've had yet! He was really caring about his students and would help people that did not understand. However, this class is not an "easy A." Prepare to do a lot of reading and notes to get an A. This was supposed to be my easiest class but ended up being the hardest. Quizzes and daily work due weekly.

Professor Lamb is a great teacher, but if you are expecting an easy A, this is not the class for you. You have to read and study the textbooks and take detailed notes during the lecture in order to be successful on the quizzes.
He doesnt care if you come to class and usually has a day dedicated to asking questions before tests

He's a laid back guy and will joke around with the class, but still serious about getting stuff done. Very good about asking if people are understanding things and willing to go over things multiple times so that we understood.

Absolutely willing to help you if you go and ask him. You can sometimes get credit back after a test if you talk to him and show him you understand the material. If he gives you a graph of any kind, I can guarantee that you will see it again, unless he explicitly says you won't. Know how to move within the graphs with fractional composition

The tests are very hard and detailed over the smallest things. I would get the textbook and read all of the chapters he goes over in class as well as attend class. The only grades for the class are 3 tests and the final. Also does not round up final grade. I ended up with a C when i had a 79.5 in the class.
